english.title: Maker of unregistered foreign activity requirement carry out relevant activity
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having made a foreign activity arrangement that had not been registered under section 65 of the National Security Act 2023,

(A)_[carried out a relevant activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..),]_
(B)_[arranged for a relevant activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), to be carried out]_

in the United Kingdom, when you knew, or having regard to other matters known, ought to have known, that you were acting pursuant to a foreign activity arrangement
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 67(2) and 80(1) of the National Security Act 2023.

english.notes:
(i) If this this offence is committed, it is likely the offence under section 65 will also apply (failure to register) see H101461.
(ii) Section 68 provides a second set of ‘enhanced tier’ registration requirements under the foreign influence registration scheme. Section 68 focusses on activities conducted by specified persons themselves, rather those that they are directing through an arrangement that would need to be registered under section 65. See H101464, H101464 and H101466 for offences under section 68.
(iii) Section 69 provides a requirement to register a foreign influence arrangement made with a foreign power. See H101467 for the associated offence under section 69.
